summary: Completed full e2e testing of Lourdes Storm Tracker app. All 17 backend API tests passed. Frontend dashboard, auth, and favorites flows all working correctly.
seed_data_creation: Test user test@lourdes.fr was already created. Additional test users created during testing with TEST_ prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All APIs working: /api/ (service info), /api/weather/current, /api/weather/forecast, /api/weather/history, /api/storms/zones, /api/auth/register, /api/auth/login, /api/auth/me, /api/favorites (CRUD). Frontend dashboard loads with Leaflet map, sidebar with current conditions, CAPE gauge, history chart, forecast chart. Auth dialog works for login/register. Favorites CRUD works when authenticated. Map recenters when selecting a favorite.

backend: GET /api/ - returns service info with Lourdes coordinates (43.0951, -0.0434, 20km radius)
GET /api/weather/current - returns current weather with temperature, CAPE, lightning_potential
GET /api/weather/forecast - returns 24 hourly entries with precipitation_probability, cape, lightning_potential
GET /api/weather/history - returns past 24h with is_storm field
GET /api/storms/zones - returns ~25 zones with storm_active, max_cape, max_lightning_potential
POST /api/auth/register - creates user and returns JWT token
POST /api/auth/login - authenticates valid credentials, rejects invalid
GET /api/auth/me - returns user with token, 401 without
POST /api/favorites - creates favorite for authenticated user
frontend: Dashboard loads with map (Leaflet), sidebar, current conditions, CAPE gauge, history chart, forecast chart
Auth dialog opens with login/register forms
Adding a favorite via UI works
Selecting a favorite recenters the map
